sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed by the petitioner seeking the following reliefs:-
"i) To declare that the petitioner has got deemed license under the D & O Rules for conducting "Azad Margin Free Super Market"
in sho No.II/159 of Kanjoor Grama Panchayat.
ii) To issue a writ of mandamus or any other appropriate writ order or direction, directing the respondents to issue a certificate showing that the petitioner has got deemed license under the Kerala Panchayat Raj Act and D & O Rules for conducting Azad Margin Free Super Market in shop No.II/159 of Kanjoor Grama Panchayat.
iii) To grant such other reliefs which this Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper in the circumstances of the case.
2. The case projected by the petitioner is that, the business was being conducted by the petitioner from the year 2012 onwards, after securing D & O license from the Secretary of the Panchayat.

However, when the petitioner submitted the application for the year 2018-2019, the same was not issued and thereupon, petitioner has secured deemed license by virtue of Section 236(3) of the Kerala Panchayat Raj Act, 1994.
3. Anyway, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that, petitioner was continuing the business without any interference from the Panchayat, in view of the deemed license.

In my considered view,
the financial year is to end on 31.03.2019.
Therefore, if the petitioner is continuing with the business, no interference shall be made by the Panchayat, since the petitioner has already secured a deemed license in accordance with law.
4. There will be a direction to the Secretary of the Grama Panchayat to issue a license in the paper form to the petitioner, having validity up to 31.03.2019.
The writ petition is disposed of, accordingly.

Sd/-
SHAJI P.CHALY JUDGE uu 14.02.2019
